# Workspace archive golden fixtures

- `minimal-v1.json` and `saxpy-v1.json` were emitted byte-for-byte by the archive writer at commit `97c821a`. They are immutable compatibility inputs and must never be regenerated by the current writer.
- `minimal-v2.json` is a checked-in current-format archive used to detect accidental codec changes.
- `corrupted-v1.json` has an intentionally invalid v1 envelope checksum; verification must fail before migration.
- `future-v3.json` contains an unsupported future version header; it must be rejected without approximate decoding.

The compact one-line encoding is intentional: v1 integrity hashes cover the exact deterministic body codec defined by the legacy Rust structs.
